intentions.title: Provide an agent-native task substrate — task documents ARE the coordination layer, replacing Beads/bd entirely
intentions.evidence: Barkpark.Tasks.{Claim,Close,Queue,Edges} implement claim/claim_by_id/close/dependency edges directly over `type:"task"` Documents; CLAUDE.md states 'Beads (bd/.beads/) is RETIRED — do not reinstate it. Use bp task for ALL task tracking.'; Barkpark.Tasks.Query powers `bp task ready`/prime/lookup.

intentions.title: Guarantee exactly-once claim semantics under concurrent multi-agent workers via row locking + CAS + advisory locks
intentions.evidence: claim.ex: `Repo.transaction` + `lock: "FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED"` on the ready query; claim_by_id/3 takes a `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('task:'<>doc_id))` before reading; do_claim/4 does an optimistic `WHERE id=... AND rev=...` update_all and returns `{:error, :stale_claim}` on 0 rows updated.

intentions.title: Detect and recover crashed-agent claims automatically (no task is permanently unreapable)
intentions.evidence: ttl_sweeper.ex: Oban worker scans `in_progress` tasks with stale/NULL `claim.ts_iso`, bumps `claim.epoch` (fencing kick) under the same advisory lock key close/3 uses, flips lifecycle back to `open`, clears the worker — so any late write from the dead worker is rejected as `:fenced_off`.

intentions.title: Prevent silent, stale closes — a worker cannot close a task whose brief changed under it without acknowledging the drift
intentions.evidence: work_digest.ex computes per-field digests over title/description/acceptance_criteria at claim time; close.ex recomputes and refuses (`changed_fields`) when the digest drifted; deliberately narrower than a raw rev CAS so unrelated self-edits (labels, code_refs) don't trip the fence.

intentions.title: Model and enforce a real dependency graph between tasks (blockers, discovered-from) driving readiness
intentions.evidence: edge.ex: typed `task_edges` schema (`blocks`, `discovered-from`, extensible kind column); edges.ex/query.ex compute unmet-blocker counts; claim.ex `check_deps_satisfied/1` refuses a targeted claim while any `blocks` dependency isn't `done`; TtlSweeper/Close cascade unblock dependents.

intentions.title: Prevent duplicate task births via similarity-scored find-or-create with an auditable escape hatch
intentions.evidence: dedup.ex: `check_new_task/5` only gates genuine births (`prev_doc == nil`), scores candidates via Tasks.Similarity/Judge, fails open on fetch errors, and honors `content.distinct_from` as both bypass and persisted rejection trail — 'a bogus distinct_from cannot bypass a real duplicate'.

intentions.title: Expose safe, closed-vocabulary aggregate/rollup queries over the task graph for dashboards and PortableDoc data-viz blocks — without leaking tenant data through small buckets
intentions.evidence: query.ex `agg_for_query/3`: whitelisted groupBy dims/time buckets/measures (never a caller-supplied jsonb path), k-anonymity suppression (`@k_anon 5`) on sum/avg/min/max cells and totals, field-visibility cross-check via `Envelope.field_readable?` before exposing any measure, fail-closed tenancy via `Scope.scope_to_workspace/3`.

intentions.title: Enforce a stable, permissive-but-shaped content contract for task documents so every writer (CLI, engine, legacy) stays compatible
intentions.evidence: validation.ex: required `kind`/`lifecycle_status` enum, shape-only (never sub-key) checks on dossier fields (description, criteria, worklog, landed, distinct_from, etc.), explicitly loose to keep 'the bp task CLI, engine CAS updates, legacy docs' green.
